messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Return Nothing from a reactivePrint() statement
parts:
I was checking to see if this bug has been resolved...

I use reactivePrint() to call a function that prints all the necessary information.  I use invisible() in this function to return nothing, however there is still a line that says NULL in my output (presumably because NULL is passed back to reactivePrint()).  How can I get around this?

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!topic/shiny-discuss/xZwzgMKsTaE


Thanks

parts:
NULL is still appearing.  Example code:

server.R

library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$test <- reactivePrint(function() {
    if(input$actionTest!=0){
      return(isolate({
        print('1')
        invisible()
    }))

}else{return(invisible())}
  })
  
})
  

ui.R

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  
  actionButton('actionTest','Start'),
  verbatimTextOutput("test")
  
))
